name: v5.69.0
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

Built from Linode API spec: [20260917](https://github.com/linode/linode-api-openapi/releases/tag/release-20260917)

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Parser fix for unknown nested-list objects by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/920
* Fix several issues with oneof responses by @ezilber-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/924
* Fixed bug causing deeply nested object lists to be improperly displayed by @ezilber-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/925
### 🚀 New Features
* Add integration tests for Reserved IP for IPv4 by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/886
* Add integration tests for Configurable VPC top-level IPv4 Prefixes by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/905
* Add integration tests for RDMA interfaces by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/908
### 💡 Improvements
* Add `AGENTS.md` files by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/912
* Enhance security of kubeconfig file permission by @yec-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/919
* Update OCI publish workflow auth to OIDC by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/918
### 🧪 Testing Improvements
* Remove unsupported parameters from test_interface_settings_update by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/900
* Support CFW protocol "ALL" / numeric by @psnoch-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/917
* Refactor and fixes of integration tests by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/909
### ⚙️ Repo/CI Improvements
* Add security release label by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/907
* Add community contribution and hotfix labels by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/910
* Fix GitHub Actions script injection vulnerabilities by @zliang-akamai in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/906
* Add merge readiness check by @mawilk90 in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/911
### 📖 Documentation
* Update README install instructions to use pipx by @CodeBySayak in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/877
### 📦 Dependency Updates
* build(deps): bump docker/setup-qemu-action from 4.0.0 to 4.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/897
* build(deps): bump pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish from 1.13.0 to 1.14.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/899
* build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.0.0 to 4.2.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/898
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/904
* build(deps): bump softprops/action-gh-release from 2.5.0 to 3.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/902
* build(deps): bump actions/github-script from 8 to 9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/884
* build(deps): bump actions/dependency-review-action from 4 to 5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/903
* build(deps): bump pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish from 1.14.0 to 1.14.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/915
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-python from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/913
* build(deps): bump Andrew-Chen-Wang/github-wiki-action from 5.0.3 to 5.0.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/875
* build(deps): bump slackapi/slack-github-action from 3 to 4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/923
* build(deps): bump softprops/action-gh-release from 3.0.1 to 3.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/922

## New Contributors
* @CodeBySayak made their first contribution in https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/877

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/compare/v5.68.0...v5.69.0
